page.overview:
Who is Darth Jerra?

Darth Jerra was an individual affiliated with the Sith. They claimed to an unspecified individual that they were not getting away this time.

Darth Jerra was created for Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught, a 2019 expansion to the 2011 BioWare video game Star Wars: The Old Republic. In the game, they are mentioned in the description for the "Jerra's Persistence" Tactical item as the author of a quote provided in it.
